:::{#def-level-set}
#### Level set

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ and let $c$ be a real number.
The **level set**
[@wikipedia_level_set]
of $f$ at $c$ is

$$
\cb{\vx \in \reals^p : f(\vx) = c},
$$

the set of points where $f$ takes the value $c$.
It is the [preimage](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-preimage) of $\cb{c}$ under $f$, so we write it $\levelsetof{c}{f}$.
For $p = 2$, a level set is often a curve in the plane.

:::
